notes: Agency GIS geometry is not current proof of open/passable/legal trails.
No fabricated straight lake-to-lake navigation tracks. A 59 m agency-boundary gap is deliberately unrendered.
All Horseshoe routes use Mammoth Pass Cutoff → Upper Crater Meadow/PCT, avoiding direct Mammoth Pass–Reds Meadow resort trail. Construction/legal access still needs ranger confirmation.
Lake pins refer to feature locations; route ends are nearest trail vertices, not designated campsites.
